rows.title: The whole view
rows.text: If you are a European rabbit, you can see all the way around you when you crouch in the freeze position, and only about 25 degrees straight ahead is seen by both eyes. You have round pupils, two kinds of color-sensing cell (blue and green), and about a tenth of the fine detail a human sees, and a review states that you have no tapetum, the reflective layer behind the retina. Nobody has measured any of this in cottontails, hares or pikas, so if you are one of those, how your eyes work is unknown.
rows.note: Left out R9 and the Iberian rabbit carry, since fields travel only within a genus; peak wavelengths dropped as they had no job.
